question: Which part of our body do we use to kick a football into a goal? ⚽
explanation: Awesome! In football, we use our strong feet and legs to kick the ball into the goal! ⚽

question: What fun game do we play mostly by kicking a round ball? 🏃
explanation: Great job! Football is a wonderful game where we run and kick the ball with our friends! ⚽
hint: The name has the word 'foot' in it.

question: What do we call the action of stopping a rolling ball with our foot? 🛑
explanation: Super! When a friend passes the ball to you, stopping it safely is called receiving! 🛑
hint: It is like welcoming a gift.

question: Which part of your foot is best for making a short, careful pass? 👟
explanation: Fantastic! The inside of your foot is flat and wide, making it perfect for a straight pass! 🦶
hint: It is the side of your foot closest to your other foot.

question: Where should your eyes look right before you kick the ball? 👀
explanation: Brilliant! Looking at the ball helps your foot hit it right in the sweet spot! 🎯
hint: Look at what you want to kick.

question: Where should your standing foot be when you kick the ball? 🧍
explanation: Awesome! Planting your standing foot right next to the ball keeps you balanced and steady! ⚖️
hint: Keep it very close to the ball.

question: Where do you aim the ball if you want to score a point? 🥅
explanation: Great job! You score a point for your team by kicking the ball into the big net called the goal! 🥅

question: What is the easiest way to trap a ball that is rolling slowly? 🐾
explanation: Super! Putting the bottom of your foot gently on top of the ball stops it perfectly! 🛑
hint: It is the part that touches the ground.

question: What happens when you kick the ball with a lot of power? ⚡
explanation: Fantastic! A strong, powerful swing of your leg sends the ball flying very far across the field! 🚀

question: What should you always wear on your feet to play football safely? 👟
explanation: Wonderful! Sports shoes protect your toes and help you run fast without slipping! 🏃

question: Who is the special player that stands in the goal to catch the ball? 🧤
explanation: Brilliant! The goalkeeper is the hero who guards the net and can use their hands! 🦸

question: What do we call sending the ball nicely to your teammate? 🤝
explanation: Awesome! Sharing the ball with a friend on your team is called a pass! 🤝

question: Which part of your foot is best for a super strong kick? 👟
explanation: Great job! The top of your foot where the shoelaces are is very strong for big kicks! ⚡
hint: It is on the top of your foot.

question: How should your body feel when you are waiting to receive a pass? 🧍
explanation: Super! Being relaxed with your knees slightly bent helps you react quickly and stop the ball! 🏃

question: What is the best thing to do right before you pass the ball? 👀
explanation: Fantastic! Looking up helps you see where your friends are standing before you kick! 👁️
hint: Use your eyes to check the field.

question: What shape is the football we use in the game? ⚽
explanation: Wonderful! A football is a round sphere, which is why it rolls so beautifully on the grass! 🟢

question: If the ball rolls away from you, what should you do? 🏃
explanation: Brilliant! Just run quickly and use your feet to bring the ball back into the game! 🏃

question: What is it called when you run while keeping the ball close to your feet? ⚽
explanation: Awesome! Taking tiny kicks to keep the ball close while you run is called dribbling! ⚽

question: How do you make a gentle pass to a friend who is very close? 👟
explanation: Great job! A soft, gentle tap with the inside of your foot is perfect for a close pass! 🤝

question: In regular football play, what body part are you not allowed to use? ✋
explanation: Super! Except for the goalie, players must only use their feet, head, or chest to touch the ball! 🚫

question: Who is the only player allowed to catch the ball with their hands? 🧤
explanation: Fantastic! The goalkeeper stays near the net and can use their hands to make awesome saves! 🧤

question: If you don't have a big net, what can you use to mark a goal? ⛺
explanation: Wonderful! Bright orange cones or even a pair of shoes make a great practice goal! ⛺

question: What makes a pass a really good pass? ⭐
explanation: Brilliant! A pass is perfect when it goes straight to your teammate so they can keep playing! 🤝
hint: It goes right to your teammate.

question: What body parts help you balance while standing on one foot to kick? ⚖️
explanation: Awesome! Spreading your arms out helps you stay balanced like an airplane when you kick! ✈️
hint: They have hands at the end.

question: What should you do right after you pass the ball to a friend? 🏃
explanation: Great job! After passing, move to an open space so your friend can pass it back to you! 🔄

question: Which kind of ball is best when you are just learning how to kick? 🧸
explanation: Super! A light, soft ball is safe and fun to use when you are learning new skills! 🎈

question: How do you know where the ball will go when you pass? 🎯
explanation: Fantastic! Looking at your target right before you kick helps your foot aim perfectly! 🎯
hint: Keep your eyes on where you want it to go.

question: How do you let a friend know you want them to pass the ball? 🗣️
explanation: Wonderful! Calling your friend's name loudly lets them know you are open and ready! 📣

question: If you want the ball to fly high in the air, where do you kick it? ⬆️
explanation: Brilliant! Kicking the very bottom, underneath the ball, makes it fly high like a bird! 🦅

question: If you want the ball to roll flat on the ground, where do you kick it? ➡️
explanation: Awesome! Kicking right in the center of the ball keeps it nice and low on the grass! 🌱
hint: Kick it right in the center.

question: What is the best surface to play a fun game of football? 🌱
explanation: Great job! A soft, green grassy field is the safest and most fun place to run and play! 🌳
hint: It is green and grows in parks.

question: What do we call the kids we are playing against? 🤝
explanation: Super! They are just friends on the other team playing the same fun game as us! 🤝

question: What should we do with our bodies before we start running and kicking? 🏃
explanation: Fantastic! Stretching and doing a warm-up gets our muscles ready for a great game! 💪

question: If you have no friends around, what is a great thing to practice kicking against? 🧱
explanation: Wonderful! A strong brick wall is a great partner because the ball bounces right back to you! 🔄
hint: It is made of strong red blocks.

question: How do we show good sportsmanship after a fun game? ✋
explanation: Brilliant! High-fiving the other team shows respect and means 'Good game!' 🤝
hint: You clap hands with your friends.

question: When you lock your foot to receive a pass, how should your ankle feel? 🦵
explanation: Awesome! Keeping your ankle firm makes sure the ball doesn't bounce away from you! 🛑

question: What is it called when you kick a ball while it is still in the air? ✈️
explanation: Great job! Kicking the ball before it touches the ground is a super cool move called a volley! 🦅

question: What helps you run faster to reach a rolling ball? 🏃
explanation: Super! Pumping your arms back and forth helps your legs move much faster across the field! 🏃
hint: Move your arms back and forth.

question: If a ball is bouncing high, what is the safest way to control it? ⬇️
explanation: Fantastic! Waiting for the ball to drop near the ground makes it much easier to trap! 🛑
hint: Wait for it to come down.

question: What kind of touch do you need to gently stop a very fast ball? ✨
explanation: Wonderful! Relaxing your foot for a soft touch absorbs the speed of the fast ball like a cushion! 🛏️

question: Why do we keep practicing passing and receiving every day? 🌟
explanation: Brilliant! Practice makes perfect! The more you kick and receive, the better your skills become! 🏆

question: What should you do to stay energized when you are running a lot? 😮‍💨
explanation: Awesome! Taking nice deep breaths gives your muscles the oxygen they need to keep running! 🌬️

question: What is the best feeling during a football game? 🎉
explanation: Great job! Kicking the ball past the goalie into the net to score a goal is super exciting! 🎉
hint: Getting a point for your team.

question: What is the best drink to have after playing a fun, sweaty game? 💧
explanation: Super! Drinking fresh water cools you down and keeps your body healthy and hydrated! 🚰

question: Which side of the foot is tricky but really fun to pass with? 🦶
explanation: Fantastic! Using the outside of your foot is a fancy trick to pass the ball quickly to the side! ✨
hint: The edge near your little toe.

question: What sound do you listen for to know when to start or stop the game? 🎶
explanation: Wonderful! The referee blows a loud whistle so all players know exactly when to start or stop! 🛑

question: How should playing sports and games with your friends make you feel? 😊
explanation: Brilliant! Sports are all about having a big smile and enjoying the sunshine with friends! 🌞

question: How should your knees be when you are getting ready to receive a ball? 🦵
explanation: Awesome! Having slightly bent knees keeps you bouncy and ready to move in any direction! 🦘

question: What happens if you kick a heavy ball really hard right with your toes? 🤕
explanation: Great job! Kicking with the toe can hurt a lot, which is why we use the inside or top of the foot! 🦶

question: What is the absolute most important rule when playing any sport? 🎉
explanation: Super! Win or lose, the best part of sports is getting healthy and having an amazing time! 🎈
